Workspace clean, validation green. Submitting iteration 14.

**Changed this iteration (14)**

- **Player** (both player references decoded — frame correlation proved `player_controls.jpg` is playing one of our own clips, diff 4.4/255): rebuilt the control chrome to match — bottom-left two circular **10-second skip** buttons (Netflix style, no play/pause in the bar), bottom-center **Title · E# · Episode name**, bottom-right **time above the icon cluster** (volume, subtitles, audio, episodes, Next, fullscreen); top bar now has the back arrow (left) and a **profile avatar with initial** (right).
- **Login** rebuilt from `login.jpg`: two-stage flow — *"Enter your info to sign in"* / *"Or get started with a new account."* / *"Email or mobile number"* / full-width red **Continue**, then a password stage with **Sign in** + "← Go back"; reCAPTCHA note under the box and the real bottom block: *"Questions? Call 1-844-569-7700"* + 4-column footer link grid (FAQ/Help Center/Netflix House/Netflix Shop; Terms/Privacy/Cookie Preferences/Corporate Information).
- **Account dropdown** rebuilt from `account_menu.jpg`: six rows — functional **Kids toggle** (switches to the user's kids profile), Manage Profiles, Transfer Profile, Account, Help Center (real external link), Sign out of Netflix; dropped the avatar header and continue-watching card (not in the reference).
- **Games page** top section: full-width backdrop banner with the featured game card bottom-left (wordmark + big display title + meta + **Play Game / More Info**), Party Games / More Games rails below.
- **Hero billboard** (Home/Shows/Movies/Genre/New & Popular): white NETFLIX wordmark above the 7.6vw display title, meta line `Genre · Year · N Seasons · Rating`, **Play + More Info** text buttons; removed the red badge and synopsis paragraph to match the references.
- **Shows**: "Genres" button moved next to the TV Shows heading, dropdown is now a 3-column panel; **New & Popular** rail order fixed ("New on Netflix" first).

**State & caveats**

- `validate` 14/14, 13/15 contract 2xx, chain 8/8; build artifacts removed before snapshot.
- The player's "ad pre-roll" caption from `player.jpg` was deliberately not simulated (we have no ad assets — a fake "begins after ads" state would be dishonest UI).
- Remaining unknowns are cosmetic: exact hero badge y-offsets and the "New Episode" hero badge (ambiguous across screenshots).
